items.title: ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-D (H4 diagnostic, corrected denominator): context-conditioned (reef vs open) committed-class TV-divergence, ARM_ON vs ARM_OFF -- supersedes V3-EXQ-847
items.note: arc_062_conversion_fanout_2026-07-29.md Section 2 Leg P-D (H4: measurement aliasing) + the 2026-08-02 active_frac denominator sweep addendum. SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-847: chip chip-20260802-v3exq847a-queue, redesign of V3-EXQ-847 per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-847_2026-08-01.md (confirmed, governance-ratified 2026-08-01T22:24:00Z). BUG FIXED: 847's mech448_demotion_lever_live_and_excluding_both_arms / mech449_active_nogo_live_and_suppressing_both_arms readiness preconditions computed active_frac = fresh-only-numerator / n_p2_ticks (ALL P2 ticks incl. held/replayed commitments) -- a basis mismatch that deflated active_frac by the held-tick fraction (40-86% across 847's 6 cells) and produced a FALSE substrate_not_ready_requeue self-route even though MECH-448/449 were actually 100% active on genuine fresh selections (847's own manifest recomputes to exactly 1.0 against n_p2_ticks - n_latched_ticks). FIX: both demotion_active_frac and nogo_active_frac now divide by n_p2_fresh_select = n_p2_ticks - n_latched_ticks, matching sibling script V3-EXQ-859's reference-correct pattern. Purely a post-hoc aggregation fix; training loop / RNG seeding / env dynamics / ARMS / hyperparameters unchanged from V3-EXQ-847. SEED SET UNCHANGED [42, 43, 44] (deliberate, investigated this build -- see script docstring PREMISE CORRECTION section): no third documented-good seed exists to substitute for degenerate seed 44 (a standalone env probe this session confirmed the seed-44 degeneracy is a TRAINED-POLICY property, not raw env geometry, so an untested seed cannot be cheaply pre-verified); seeds 42+43 alone satisfy C1g's majority-of-3 floor; extra seeds were not added since MIN_SEEDS_FOR_PASS/TV_MIN_LIFT_SEEDS are fixed absolute counts, not proportions, so adding seeds without rescaling would silently loosen every C1 subgate's majority semantics. EXPECTED OUTCOME (stated in advance): because the fix is aggregation-only and seeds/config are unchanged, this run is expected to reproduce 847's own already-known DVs (seed 43 bit-identical washout across arms, seed 44 zero reef ticks/self-excludes, seed 42 the only informative cell showing a lift OPPOSITE H4's hypothesis) -- verdict likely FAIL / non_contributory / context_divergence_not_greater_arm_on_measurement_aliasing_ruled_out. The point of this re-run is to let the readiness gate correctly recognize MECH-448/449 as live so the pipeline computes the C1/C2/C3 verdict end-to-end itself, rather than the correction living only as a hand-annotated autopsy note. Smoke (--dry-run, seed 42 only): confirmed the fix -- f_eligibility_demotion_active_frac / go_nogo_active_frac read 1.0 (28 fresh / 28 fresh, excluding 24 of 52 P2 ticks as latched) vs the old deflated ~0.538 that would have failed the 0.8 floor; demotion_non_vacuous / nogo_non_vacuous both True at toy scale. C1/C1g/C2 still read False at dry-run dose, as expected (1 seed of 3, toy episode budget -- same documented dry-run behaviour as V3-EXQ-847 itself). GOV-REUSE-1: the H4 primary DV was already reanalyzed by hand from 847's manifest in the autopsy (no re-run needed for THAT); this run exists so the corrected readiness gate + full C1-C3 pipeline runs natively, per the autopsy's own routing recommendation.

items.title: Q-004 tau_R calibration at larger training budget, selection-instrument fixed (supersedes V3-EXQ-149)

Budget: WARMUP_EPISODES 300->600 (2x), EVAL_EPISODES 100->150 (1.5x) -- sized against a REAL timed calibration (10 warmup + 5 eval eps measured 32.2 sec/episode). New non-gating readiness diagnostics (R1 candidate_action_diversity>=1.5, R2 hippo_fallback_rate<0.5) guard against the fix silently degrading back to random selection. items.title: MECH-166 wall-independent representation confirmer (sleep-cycle write-counter recording fix)
items.note: Supersedes V3-EXQ-436b (FAIL on C1, recommended_evidence_direction non_contributory per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-436b_2026-08-02.json/.md, confirmed 2026-08-02, user-approved as recommended). FIX 1 (the requested fix): 436b discarded agent.run_sleep_cycle()'s entire return value with `_ = ...`, so sws_n_writes/rem_n_rollouts were never captured. 436c captures them and adds a P0 positive-control gate (p0_readiness_gate/P0NotReady, mirroring V3-EXQ-671b's MECH-025b residue-accumulation gate) requiring both counters, pooled across all 5 SWS_THEN_REM seeds, to clear >0 before C1 (slot_cosine_sim) is scored -- unmet routes to FAIL/non_contributory/sleep_cycle_recording_gap_still_present rather than a silent, uninterpretable readout. FIX 2 (found during this session's own smoke testing, not in the original autopsy): agent._e1_tick() -- the ONLY call site in ree_core/agent.py that appends to agent._world_experience_buffer/_self_experience_buffer (SWS write-path source) and pushes into agent.theta_buffer (REM read source) -- is invoked exclusively from agent.act()-style entry points; this driver's manual harm-based action-selection loop (unchanged from 436b) calls agent.sense() directly and never agent.act(), so both stores were PERMANENTLY EMPTY regardless of the Fix-1 capture, and run_sws_schema_pass()'s n_buf<2 / run_rem_attribution_pass()'s recent-is-None guards fired on every sleep pass unconditionally -- confirmed via a standalone 200-step repro before touching the driver. This also fully explains failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-436b_2026-08-02's 'core anomaly' (slot_cosine_sim bit-identical between conditions to full float64 precision, every seed): ContextMemory.memory is an nn.Parameter randomly initialised via torch.randn(...)*0.01, and arm_cell(seed,...) reseeds torch's global RNG to the SAME seed for both conditions before each agent is constructed, so both conditions' memory started bit-identical and -- since .write() never fired in either -- never diverged. Fixed by directly feeding _world_experience_buffer/_self_experience_buffer/theta_buffer in _run_episode, mirroring _e1_tick's own append+trim+theta_buffer.update exactly, WITHOUT its other side effects (extra E1 forward pass, cue-bias/schema-salience/self-recurrence caching) which this driver's design does not otherwise exercise. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): SD-017 1 braking autopsy (V3-EXQ-538a), ARC-045 0, MECH-166 0 -- all below the >=2 threshold, brake does not fire. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (slot_cosine_sim paired comparison, now with non-zero write counters) not recorded anywhere -- 436b's own manifest is the only prior run and is exactly the defect being fixed. Smoke test (--dry-run, 11 episodes to clear SLEEP_INTERVAL=10): SWS_THEN_REM sleep_passes=1, sws_n_writes_total=8.0, rem_n_rollouts_total=6.0 (both non-zero, matching sws_consolidation_steps=8/rem_attribution_steps=6 exactly); WAKING_ONLY correctly 0.0/0.0 (no sleep phase). slot_cosine_sim now differs between conditions in the smoke (0.2068 vs 0.2224) and slot_separation is no longer pinned at 0.0 for SWS_THEN_REM (1.013) -- both were previously bit-identical/0.0 under 436b's defect. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings.
